description: Pauses (active: false) or resumes (active: true) a monitor. A paused monitor stops checking, recording heartbeats and alerting; its configuration and history are kept, and resuming restarts checks at once. Setting the state it already has changes nothing. For planned downtime on a schedule use createMaintenance instead; setMaintenanceActive acts on a maintenance window, not a monitor. Find the ID with listMonitors.

active.description: false pauses the monitor, true resumes it

monitorID.description: The ID of the monitor to pause or resume

name: setMonitorActive
title: Set Monitor Active
